finding: Model-visible actions are not guaranteed executable
evidence: Model sees actions/refs that can fail due alias, registration, stale ref, or missing adapter
recommended_power_first_action: Build actionability registry that only exposes live executable skills; convert in-scope runtime misses to recovery observations

finding: Browser stack leaks Playwright details to model
evidence: Real Alibaba reached type_text then locator timeout killed mission
recommended_power_first_action: Build browser skill spine: search/inspect/extract intents; robust ref resolution, focus/fill/press/wait/recover below model

evidence: ActionKernel wraps broad exceptions as ActionKernelError; loop blocks
recommended_power_first_action: Introduce execution result taxonomy: hard_stop vs recoverable_observation vs retryable_skill_recovery

finding: Default product dispatcher only fully wires read_only_research
evidence: Patch/code/browser/channel runtimes mostly reachable by harness, not product dispatcher
recommended_power_first_action: Promote proven power skills into product dispatcher one at a time with receipts/replay

finding: Material budget can complete unverified work
evidence: Budget completion can accept without objective_satisfied proof
recommended_power_first_action: Budget exhausted without proof should enter proof/recovery lane, not accepted completion

evidence: Budget proof only allows assert_text while real tasks need extract/wait evidence
recommended_power_first_action: Allow extract_text/wait_for_text/product cards as proof where mission is research/extraction

finding: Four browser generations exist in parallel
recommended_power_first_action: Select one model-facing browser skill; route backends under it

finding: Metadata/control-plane gates block power but do not execute
evidence: DelegatedActionGate and manifest layers are maps, not authority/execution
recommended_power_first_action: Keep as visibility only; do not add more approval packs before power path

finding: New power replay checks weaker than read-only replay
evidence: Stability counts can pass even if bad receipts are stable
recommended_power_first_action: Validate receipt schemas, mission ids, finalgate refs, receipt hashes for every power surface

finding: Some browser paths validate before action but not after navigation
evidence: Click/fill may move to ungranted origin without uniform post-action origin gate
recommended_power_first_action: Centralize post-action origin revalidation in browser skill runtime

finding: Duplicate-send marker is written after transport success
evidence: Crash after send before marker can resend
recommended_power_first_action: Pre-reserve idempotency key or write pending-send ledger before transport

finding: Core runtime has many god functions
recommended_power_first_action: Extract phase engines and descriptor registries only where it shortens future power work
